assets.title: Week 13 opener board with one feedback-ready design
assets.description: A single adult-learning fashion look, sketch, or mini board with a strong visible color palette, a clear silhouette, a visible neckline detail, a balanced overall look, and one plausible contrast-detail improvement point for a fast opener review.
assets.notes: Keep the image visually clear on a phone screen. The design must support objective visible-clue answers about the color palette, silhouette, visible neckline detail, and balanced overall look. Include one small area where adding a contrast detail is a clear and plausible suggestion so the app-checked opener answers stay defensible.

assets.notes: Keep the literal image A to image D labels visible and stable. Make each panel distinct enough that reading and listening answers stay objective. Include adult-oriented fashion sketch, caption, or critique context without clutter.
